forcedChoices.reason: The text speaks to the readers; the Spanish rules ask for plural ustedes.
'the surviving you' has no natural plural form; the emphasis stays on ustedes.

forcedChoices.choice: lo humano de ustedes ... lo divino de ustedes
forcedChoices.reason: 'the human you ... the divine you' needs a neuter form with plural ustedes.
Kept literal; the English 'surviving seraphim' can mean seraphim of survival, and the literal form leaves that open.

forcedChoices.choice: son subordinados / son coordinados / es superordinada
forcedChoices.reason: ser shows rank (equal status), not a process of co-ordination.
